text: cd "/Users/lesurmatthis/dev/projet perso/collega/collega_backend" && git show main:collega_backend/app/workers/ocr_worker.py | grep -n "reload\|refund\|rendu" ; git show main:collega_backend/app/workers/generation_worker.py | grep -n "reload\|refund\|rendu"; git show main:collega_backend/app/services/generation/card_generator.py | grep -n "reload\|refund" ; sed -n 120,180p app/api/v1/colleges.py: ception: return HTTPException( status_code=409, detail={"code": "JOB_IN_PROGRESS", "message": "Un import est déjà en cours pour ce collège"}, ) def _invalid_ref_id(ref_id: int) -> None: if not (1 <= ref_id <= 39): raise HTTPException( status_code=422, detail={"code": "INVALID_REF_ID", "message": "ref_id must be between 1 and 39"}, ) async def _select_college(db: AsyncSession, user: User, ref_id: int) -> College | None: result = await db.execute( select(College) .where(College.user_id == user.id) .where(College.college_ref_id == ref_id) ) return result.scalar_one_or_none() async def _get_or_create_college(db: AsyncSession, user: User, ref_id: int) -> College: college = await _select_college(db, user, ref_id) if college is None: college = College(user_id=user.id, college_ref_id=ref_id) db.add(college) try: await db.flush() except IntegrityError: await db.rollback() raise _job_in_progress()
